title: Permanent London Pokémon Store Will Open By 2029
content: The upcoming London store is described as being "the first physical retail space for the Pokémon brand outside of Asia." However, the announcement also adds that the London store will be the first of several permanent Pokémon stores which are planned to open in locations outside Asia.
author: ANN

title: 3 Fall 2026 Anime to Watch If You Miss One Piece
content: One Piece is following a new format starting in 2026, with only 26 episodes released per year. This was a surprising change, as fans had become accustomed to the series airing weekly on Sundays, with occasional breaks.
author: ComicBook

title: LOVELYZ's Ye-in Jeong Joins The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call Seasons 2-3
content: Jeong joins returning cast members Ji-Hoon Ju as surgeon Kang-hyuk Baek, Young-woo Choo as Jae-won Yang, Kyung-ho Yoon as Yu-rim Han, and Jae-kwang Jeong as anesthesiologist Gyeong-won Park. Do-yun lee, who directed the first season, will return as director and screenwriter.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4 Preview Teases Nacht Fighting Two Supreme Devils
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 4 (Episode 174 overall) ahead of its October 24 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Devil Union Asta visual following Episode 3.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Director Breaks Silence on Biggest Change in Season 3
content: The Apothecary Diaries is taking all the spotlight this Fall 2026 anime season with its exciting Season 3. There’s no denying it’s one of the biggest shows of the 2020s, not only within the Seinen demographic but also compared to all the major genres as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Scriptwriter Toyoto Kogisu Dies at 69
content: Kogisu contributed as a writer for several episodes of the Detective Conan anime between 2000-2018, including the 733rd episode "The Wedding Reception and the Two Gunshots" (pictured right). He has also written scripts for live-action series such as Taiyō ni Hoero!
author: ANN

title: Tim Burton’s Failed Sci-Fi Movie From the ’90s Could Have Been a Game Changer for Manga
content: Tim Burton has made a career out of making weirdos look cool. Beetlejuice is a walking bad decision. Edward Scissorhands has blenders for hands. Sweeney Todd’s demon barber speaks for itself.
author: ComicBook

title: Shigeru Miyamoto Becomes 1st Game Creator to be Honored With Japan's Order of Culture Award
content: At a press conference at Nintendo in Kyoto, Miyamoto stated that as games are created by not just one person, but by many collaborating together, he honors their work with this award. The Emperor will present Miyamoto with the award on November 3, Japan's Culture Day.
author: ANN
